# Midday alert, Wed Oct 14, 2026 (Research Inc., ~12:25 PM ET)

**Hot CPI revives an Oct 28 Fed hike; Nasdaq and semis lead the drop.**

- Sept CPI +0.6% MoM, 3.7% YoY vs 3.6% est; core +0.3% MoM, 2.6% YoY (above est). ([US News/Reuters](https://money.usnews.com/investing/news/articles/2026-10-14/hot-september-cpi-sends-rate-hike-bets-soaring))
- 2y +14bp to 4.93%, 10y +10bp to 5.31%; Nasdaq 100 −1.0%, S&P ~−0.7%, semis down a 7th day, AMD −3.5%; health care up. ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62360140/nasdaq-100-drops-1-on-hot-cpi-soxx-falls-7th-day-stock-market-today))
- BAC −7.9%, already on avoid. ([TradingNews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sp-500-sinks-to-7741-nasdas-break-below-27000-dow-holds-51610-as-hot-cpi-hits))

**Desk read (long-only swing):** Tickers: QQQ, SPY, IWM, NVDA, AMD, AVGO, ASML. Hold off on new chip/high-beta entries until yields settle; size down ASML idea. No new avoids; PPI Thu 8:30 is the next test.
